title: Clothed MakeHuman scale figure
conversion: HM08 base mesh and 163-bone skeleton; normalized MakeHuman skin weights; MakeClothes MHCLO barycentric fitting and mapped skin weights; Blender surface smoothing and skinned GLB export. Joint actions and navigation run locally in Three.js.
materials: Body, clothes, hair and shoes use local PBR colours. Brown eye texture is the original CC0 MakeHuman texture. Source LFS diffuse/normal textures were unavailable and are not represented as included.
anthropometry: One adult base shape, uniformly scaled. Not a scan of a real person or a range of body types.
